reply_lines: A sticky note tells me your rules at the start of every chat!
It saves you from saying the same thing over and over.
When you close the chat, I forget. That is just how I work!
A sticky note fixes that — it reminds me every single time.
Good sticky notes say things like 'always be kind' or 'use small words'.
Short and clear is best — let us plan your note!
Put the sticky note at the very start of your chat.
Then I read it before I do anything else!
Hi! I am Claude. Let us plan a sticky note together!
What rule would you want me to follow?
